name: Marketo MA
description: Integration with Adobe Marketo marketing automation: Munchkin page tracking plus REST-API lead capture and sync.

suggests.drupal/encrypt: Encrypt secrets directly in Drupal's config.
suggests.drupal/key: Use the Key module to load secrets from various sources.

project_description: Adds Adobe Marketo marketing-automation capability to a Drupal site. It injects the Munchkin JavaScript tracker (by Munchkin Account ID) so page views can be associated with known leads, and/or synchronises lead data to Marketo's OAuth-authenticated REST API (via the neclimdul/marketo-rest library). Lead data can be captured from user registration/login/profile updates (marketo_ma_user), from Webform submissions (marketo_ma_webform), and from core Contact forms with contact_storage (marketo_ma_contact / marketo_ma_contact_block). REST syncs can be immediate or batched to a queue processed on cron. Tracking is filtered by page path and by user role. Secrets (REST client id/secret and the Munchkin API private key) are read through a pluggable Secrets layer that supports plain config, the Encrypt module, or the Key module. The 3.x branch is built on the maintained GuzzleHttp-based neclimdul/marketo-rest client; the optional marketo_ma_legacy_client submodule swaps in the old, unmaintained Guzzle 3 CSD\Marketo client (PHP 8 incompatible).
